Fetch MI Social data

Source: R/dados.R
mds_data.Rd

Main retrieval function. Returns monthly municipal values of the requested fields as a tidy long tibble: one row per field x municipality x month in which the API has a value.

Usage

mds_data(fields, periods = NULL, localities = "BR", validate = TRUE)

Arguments

fields

Character vector of field names. See mds_fields() for the curated list and mds_api_fields() for everything the API has.

periods

Periods to fetch:

  • NULL (default): the last 12 months up to the current month;

  • a negative number -n: the last n months up to the current month;

  • years (2024) and/or months as YYYYMM (202401, "202401").

localities

"BR" (all of Brazil), state abbreviations ("PE") or 2-digit state codes (26), and/or 6- or 7-digit IBGE municipality codes (2611606), in any combination. Default "BR".

validate

Logical. Check that fields not in the dictionary exist in the API before requesting data? Default TRUE. Local checks (names, periods, localities) always run.

Value

A tibble with columns locality_id (6-digit code used by the API), ibge_code (7-digit IBGE code), locality_name, state, period ("YYYYMM"), field, label, unit and value (double). The time of the request is kept in attr(x, "retrieved_at").

Details

The query is validated before any data request (field names, period format, locality codes), then paged through Solr and, when many municipality codes are given, split into several requests whose results are bound together.

Values are returned as published. Note that the API answers 0 for months that were not published yet; use mds_drop_unpublished() to remove those trailing zeros explicitly.

Only numeric fields are supported: a field whose values are text (such as regiao) is an error rather than an empty result.

Every response is checked before it is used: a partial or malformed answer, a total that changes while paging, a document read twice, a document without municipality or month, a field with several values in one document, or two different values for the same municipality, month and field are errors (classes misocialr_error_response and misocialr_error_conflict). A requested municipality that returns no document raises a warning.

Options: misocialr.timeout (seconds per request, default 180) and misocialr.quiet (TRUE hides the progress messages).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
mds_data(
  c("bpc_ben_i", "cadsuas_qtd_cras_i"),
  periods = 2025,
  localities = c(2611606, 2607901)
)
}
